name: build-fleet
description: Spec-driven multi-agent software house you drive with five commands (start, build, ship, fix, status): product-owner, architect, coder, qa, devops, scribe, classifier, and read-only reviewer subagents executing a hook-gated SPEC → REVIEW → FINALIZE → BUILD → CHANGE_REVIEW → HANDOFF state machine, with a human-ratified product planning tier and a reproducing-test-gated bug lane. Deterministic gates, bounded review cycles, first-class human escalation, configurable per-item review rosters and cycle budgets, a governed generate-then-pin lane for authoring novel workflows, headless orchestrator support, a convergent bounded review loop (delta review, in-workflow ADR disposition, rubric-only finalize gate, spec/criteria/cycle caps), and risk-proportionate review: a classifier risk axis seeds the review roster and budget by tier and risk, and CHANGE_REVIEW exits on a deterministic rubric gate.
